content_sections.heading: MPESB Group 2 Subgroup 4 Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: All 200 Patwari posts under this notification are reserved exclusively for Divyang (persons with disabilities) candidates, distributed across districts of Madhya Pradesh. Disability categories are EH (hearing impaired), LD (locomotor disability), and MD (multiple disabilities) - each category gets 2% horizontal reservation (6% total). Visually impaired candidates are not eligible for the Patwari post, as per the Revenue Department's order dated 11 May 2009. District-wise distribution (top districts by vacancy count) is summarized below; the complete post-code-wise list is in the official notification. The remaining districts (Agar Malwa, Alirajpur, Anuppur, Ashok Nagar, Chhatarpur, Damoh, Dewas, Dindori, Harda, Indore, Jabalpur, Katni, Khandwa, Mandla, Narmadapuram, Narsinghpur, Neemuch, Panna, Raisen, Rajgarh, Ratlam, Satna, Seoni, Shahdol, Shajapur, Shivpuri, Sidhi, Singrauli, Tikamgarh, Ujjain, Umaria, Vidisha) each have 1–5 posts; the exact post-code and district-wise break-up is given in Chapter 1 of the official notification. Beyond Patwari, the same combined exam covers 2,106 posts across a large number of Madhya Pradesh government departments, corporations, and boards. The list is extensive (100+ distinct post/department combinations); the largest-vacancy posts are summarized below. This is a partial list highlighting the larger-vacancy posts; the full department/office-wise vacancy and reservation table (covering all 2,106 posts, pages 21–126 of the notification) should be checked on the official MPESB portal before applying, since eligibility, pay scale, and job location differ by post and department.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Group 2 Subgroup 4 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination is an online Computer-Based Test (CBT) of 200 multiple-choice questions for 200 marks, to be completed in 3 hours (2 hours of actual answering time within a 3-hour reporting/instruction/exam window per shift). Candidates must carry Aadhaar registration proof and a valid original photo ID (Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Passport) to the exam centre - multi-level biometric verification is mandatory both at entry and during the exam. Electronic devices (mobile phones, calculators, log tables, digital watches, sunglasses, etc.) are strictly prohibited in the exam hall.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Group 2 Subgroup 4 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility of candidates as filled in the online application is treated as provisional and is not verified by MPESB at the application stage - actual document/certificate verification for the Patwari (Divyang) posts is done by a document verification committee constituted in the candidate's allotted district after the exam, with disability certificates further verified by the District Medical Board (and, in special cases, the Divisional Medical Board). For the other Group-2 Subgroup-4 posts, the concerned recruiting department verifies educational, technical, and professional qualification certificates of successful candidates based on the final merit list from the written exam.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPESB Group 2 Subgroup 4 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: esb.mponline.gov.in . Complete the profile registration form with your personal details. Log in and fill in the online application form, selecting the relevant post(s)/post code(s) - Patwari (Divyang) applicants must additionally submit required documents directly to the concerned department by hard copy where specified (see note below). Upload the required documents as per the specified format. Pay the applicable exam fee plus the MP Online portal fee. Submit the form and retain a copy of the application number for future reference. Note for special Adim Janjati (Baiga, Sahariya/Saharia, Bharia) candidates: For non-executive posts, such candidates must send their application with all necessary certificates, in hard copy, directly to the concerned department (using Format-2 in the notification) before the application closing date, rather than through MPESB - applications sent to MPESB by this category for such posts will be treated as invalid.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a special recruitment drive by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board for 200 Patwari posts reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD/Divyang category), conducted under the Group-2 Sub-Group-4 Combined Recruitment Examination 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 200 Patwari vacancies are available, distributed across 44 districts of Madhya Pradesh and reserved for the PwD/Divyang category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 18 August 2026. Corrections to the submitted form can be made until 23 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a graduate degree from a recognised university, along with a CPCT score card with Hindi typing (or the ability to clear it within 3 years of probation after appointment).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years as on 1 January 2026 for Madhya Pradesh permanent resident candidates applying under this PwD category recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 250 for MP domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD candidates, plus an additional MP Online portal fee of Rs. 20–60 depending on the mode of submission.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Indian citizens who are permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh, hold a graduate degree, and have a valid disability certificate in the Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, or Multiple Disability/Autism/Intellectual Disability/Mental Illness category are eligible. Visually impaired candidates are not eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official MPESB website, www.esb.mp.gov.in, between 4 August 2026 and 18 August 2026. Offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 200-mark computer-based online exam, followed by a percentile-based merit list, district allotment through a single round of counselling, and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for MPESB Patwari?
faq.answer: The Patwari post carries a pay scale of Rs. 5,200–20,200 with Grade Pay of Rs. 2,100, with a graded stipend of 70%, 80%, and 90% of the minimum pay during the three-year probation period.
